why_ai: A licensed landscape architect seals grading and planting plans and carries the liability, and clients rehire on relationship and track record.
why_clarity: Codes and standards bound the deliverable, but every site is different and whether it drains or the plants live is known years later.
why_digital: Design happens in CAD from survey data and site visits and ships as drawings, but firms are hired locally through qualifications-based selection.

why_ai: Public park work is won on trust built through past parks and decided in public meetings, with sealed documents and slow, political feedback.
why_clarity: Part persuasion, part documents; outcomes such as use, bids and planting survival arrive late and are rarely measured.
why_digital: Drawings and GIS are digital, but selection is local and engagement happens in rooms with residents.

why_ai: Plans are adopted in contested public hearings where the planner's credibility with residents and council is the product.
why_clarity: An adopted plan is a political outcome; methods vary by planner and whether the plan worked is never cleanly graded.
why_digital: Works from surveys, comments and GIS and delivers a document, but is bought locally and requires showing up at meetings.

why_ai: Sealed bid documents for public parks carry professional liability and require site knowledge and contractor-facing judgement.
why_clarity: Success is checkable at bid opening against a fixed budget, though design choices still vary by firm.
why_digital: Documents are produced on screen from survey data, but projects are local and administered on site.

why_ai: Sealed site plans carry liability, but developers treat landscape as a cost line and switch firms on price and speed.
why_clarity: Code tables and budgets define much of the deliverable; aesthetic quality and long-term performance are judged loosely.
why_digital: CAD production from digital site plans for developers who often work across regions with remote consultants.

why_ai: The landscape architect must physically inspect plants, grades and materials on site and certify completion under their licence.
why_clarity: Specifications and nursery standards define conformance, and defects are visible on site, though judgement calls remain.
why_digital: Starts from physical work on site and is done in person, but submittal review, RFIs and observation reports are digital production.

why_ai: Choosing species for a specific microclimate rests on regional judgement whose outcome appears years later.
why_clarity: Taste and regional know-how dominate, experts differ, and survival is known only after several seasons, if ever.
why_digital: Plant selection and schedules are done on screen from data and catalogues, delivered as drawings.

why_ai: The principal seals every plan personally and sells on a local relationship, though routine residential work faces cheaper substitutes.
why_clarity: Small residential and commercial sets repeat in form, but each site differs and errors surface after construction.
why_digital: CAD design from limited site data for clients found locally and met in person.

why_ai: Agency reviewers exercise delegated authority over public projects and are durable public employees, with moderate judgement.
why_clarity: Review is against written agency standards and recurs across projects, with deviations checkable on the drawing.
why_digital: Review happens on screen against submitted documents; the role is in-house, so there is no external buying.

why_ai: Applying written ordinance ratios to countable drawing objects is rule-bound work AI can absorb, with only occasional certification.
why_clarity: Each provision is an exact, checkable rule applied the same way on every project, and reviewers return pass or fail.
why_digital: Starts from code text and CAD quantities and ends in tables and worksheets, all on screen.

why_ai: Coordinating sheets, schedules and details is mechanical drafting work that software and offshore bureaus already absorb.
why_clarity: Coordination is deterministic and recurs every milestone, with errors objectively detectable.
why_digital: Entirely CAD-based production delivered as digital sets, often outsourced remotely.

why_ai: Survey design and benchmarking are screen work, but client cities hire a firm whose method and benchmarks they trust.
why_clarity: The survey method is codified and repeated across hundreds of communities with a defined report format.
why_digital: Works from survey responses and delivers reports remotely to cities nationwide.

why_ai: Arborists must walk and assess each tree on site, though canopy mapping from imagery is increasingly automated.
why_clarity: Inventory protocols are standardised and repeated city to city, with tree condition checkable on revisit.
why_digital: Field data collection on physical trees, then GIS analysis delivered as datasets and plans.

why_ai: Underwriting and claims judgement on design failures is adversarial and slow-feedback, with regulated accountability.
why_clarity: Underwriting rules exist, but claims are case-specific and outcomes take years to resolve.
why_digital: Works from applications and claim files and delivers policies and decisions remotely.

why_ai: Sizing a manufacturer's own system to a site is calculation work that software and AI can increasingly do.
why_clarity: Sizing follows the manufacturer's codified method on thousands of near-identical requests, checkable against criteria.
why_digital: Takes digital site data and returns calculations and layouts by email.

why_ai: Specification support is relationship selling backed by routine design work that tools can automate.
why_clarity: Irrigation design and specification follow product rules and recur across projects.
why_digital: Mostly screen-based design support, with reps visiting specifiers in person.

why_ai: Research supporting design is novel and judgement-heavy, but sits in firms that could buy analytics instead.
why_clarity: Each study is bespoke with no agreed definition of success and slow feedback.
why_digital: Data modelling and publication on screen, sold within the studio's national client base.

why_ai: Software and content curation are directly exposed to AI-native design tools.
why_clarity: Product releases have defined features but uneven content quality, with moderate feedback from users.
why_digital: A fully digital product sold and supported online.

why_ai: Acquisitions turn on relationships with sellers and high-stakes judgement about people and culture.
why_clarity: Each deal is bespoke and its success is judged years after closing.
why_digital: Diligence runs on documents, but deals are negotiated in person with local owners.

why_ai: Public programmes allocate funds under statutory authority, a role that persists regardless of AI.
why_clarity: Scoring criteria are written and applied to recurring rounds, but whether funded parks delivered is rarely measured.
why_digital: Applications and reviews are digital, with some site inspections.

why_ai: Specification reps sell on relationships with designers, supported by routine detail and spec content.
why_clarity: Specification support repeats across projects with standard products, though selling outcomes vary.
why_digital: Physical products sold through reps who visit design offices, with digital details as support.

why_ai: Certification review against published credits is documentary work with modest judgement.
why_clarity: Credits are written criteria applied to submitted documentation, checkable by reviewers.
why_digital: Fully online submission and review.

why_ai: Licensing authority is statutory and accountable, and demand persists because the law requires it.
why_clarity: Licensure rules and exam standards are codified and applied to recurring candidates.
why_digital: Applications and computer-based exams are digital, administered within each state.

why_ai: Plan approval is a statutory public function with site inspections, durable regardless of AI.
why_clarity: Review applies written ordinances to submitted plans and returns pass or correction, recurring daily.
why_digital: Plans are reviewed digitally, but the function is local to each jurisdiction.

why_ai: Member surveys and case studies are screen work AI can assist heavily, sustained by membership.
why_clarity: Surveys repeat annually with set formats, but case-study quality is loosely judged.
why_digital: Fully digital surveys and publications delivered to members online.
